column3: Ayase Route ・ Happy End
Several years later...
A lot has happened...
But with the blessings of our friends, we finally tied the knot.
Our days of happiness were passing in the blink of an eye and little by little, our daily lives were changing.
...Hey, it's about time, isn't it?
...Yes, it is. Onii-san.
...Oh, why the old nickname?
I was recalling the time when we had just met.
Geh...
I don't know what he was remembering, but my husband's face turned pale.
No matter how many years it's been, that expression always looks so childish. I couldn't help but laugh a bit.
Haha, what did you remember?
One of those times when you high-kicked me with a demonic expression on your face.
Oh, want me to kick you for old times' sake?
Don't. It's bad for your body.
He hasn't changed at all. He's still a lecher, an idiot, a pervert, a siscon...
And a very kind person.
The one I love.
You know, I never thought we'd actually get married.
When we first met, I didn't even imagine it.
Yes, me too.
He proposed to me soon after he got a job at a local company.
He declared his love for me in front of my parents, as he had once done for Kirino.
Then...
I'm back!
Oh! Hey, Kirino, don't just barge in here. Advertise your presence like a normal person.
Ehehe, I wanted to surprise you!
How old are you? Still a kid?
Sorry, sorry. Oh yeah, souvenir for you.
Kirino! Long time no see!
Ayase! Long time no see! How've you been?
Just fine! It's great to see that you haven't changed.
Of course. Just who do you think I am?
With that, my best friend smiled at me just like she did in the past.
Kirino, now all grown up, radiated a beauty that made me lose myself in fascination for a moment.
She's currently enjoying life as a pro model in Europe.
She came back to Japan today, after several years abroad.
But you know... Your stomach's gotten pretty big. It's due soon, isn't it?
Yes. It's a girl.
Oh! A girl! I see. I guess I'll stay in Japan for a while then.
Eh, really?
Of course. I want to be second after you to see my niece's face.
Don't be stupid. The second to see her is me.
Huh? But I want to!
...She's as selfish as always.
You say something?
Not really. But soon enough, you'll be an aunt.
Wait! T-T-T-That's... something you should never say to a girl!
Oh, you two... Don't start fighting right away after not seeing each other for so long.
I smiled as I rebuked them for their never-ending bickering.
Hey, you too... When the baby's born, you'll be a dad, right?
Yeah, that's right.
And... Ayase will be a mom.
...Yes.
Dad will be a grandpa, Mom will be a grandma. But all I get to be... is an aunt? *sigh*
The passing of time is pretty scary.
Kirino smiled stiffly as her shoulders dropped in resignation.
Onii-san put a hand on her head, a wry smile on his face.
In the past, this would've made me jealous... Now, I see it as a symbol of happiness.
Watching these siblings get along, I gently rubbed my swollen stomach and silently prayed.
May these peaceful days never end.
